name: The St Regis Singapore
insider_take: Where timeless elegance meets Singapore's heartbeat—this is luxury hospitality perfected in the Lion City.
whats_special: Singapore's first St. Regis property stands majestically on Tanglin Road, featuring the world's largest hand-cut crystal chandelier in its ballroom and housing one of Asia's most impressive collections of contemporary art. The hotel's signature Astor Bar recreates the glamour of New York's St. Regis with handcrafted cocktails including the original Bloody Mary, invented at the brand's flagship property in 1934.
pro_tip: Book the Presidential Suite for access to the exclusive rooftop infinity pool—it's one of Singapore's best-kept secrets with unobstructed city skyline views.
dont_miss: The legendary St. Regis Butler Service available 24/7, and LaBrezza restaurant's weekend brunch featuring fresh Italian cuisine with Marina Bay views. Step outside to explore the nearby Singapore Botanic Gardens (UNESCO World Heritage site) and Orchard Road's world-class shopping, both just minutes away.
pros: Signature St. Regis Butler service providing personalized attention
Prime location on Orchard Road near luxury shopping and dining
Elegant rooms with sophisticated decor and modern amenities
Exceptional dining venues including rooftop bar with city views
cons: Busy urban location may not suit guests seeking tranquility
